_notes: Copy this file to watchlist.json and replace the examples.
keep_snapshots: how many dated snapshots to keep per page. Default 8.
competitors: one entry per company. name is how it appears in the report.
urls: the pages to watch. Homepages, pricing pages and product pages work best.
ignore: optional regular expressions. A sentence, heading or button that matches is left out of the comparison. Use it for rotating counters, promo banners or anything else that changes every week.
In JSON, write a backslash twice. For example "\\d+ customers" matches '120 customers'.
Only watch pages you are allowed to fetch. The tool checks robots.txt and skips pages it disallows.
